dynasties.sourceNote: Historical imperial line associated with the family name Chai. At the current setting date a sorcerer lord at Carcosa claims to be the sixty-ninth Yellow Emperor.

dynasties.name: Dynasty of Khiara the Great
dynasties.sourceNote: Current hereditary god-empress dynasty of Leng, founded by Khiara the Great. The canonical family surname is not known.
